newsitem.title: USA: Lehman closes some metal trade,scaling back natgas.
newsitem.headline: Lehman closes some metal trade,scaling back natgas.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc, the U.S. based investment bank, said it has closed its gold trading operations and laid off some natural gas traders and sources said further restructuring of its global metals operations is is on the way.
"At least eight staff have been laid off," one industry source said.
A company spokesman confirmed the gold desk had been closed, but no further details were available.
The spokesman also said three natural gas traders out of a total 16 had been laid off.
Lehman staff members confirmed a restructuring of some of the bank's commodity trading operations was underway.
Industry sources said staff layoffs would affect most of Lehman's precious metals traders, some base metals staff in London, and some natural gas traders.
"It wouldn't surprises me given that people have not made a lot of money in metal trading lately," said Raphael Soifer, an analyst at Brown Brothers Harriman who tracks Lehman.
